summary: When a peaceful demon speaks to a polymorphed demon hero, minion.c demon_talk() checks tele_restrict() and discards rloc()’s return while retaining its relocation side effect. The JS demon_talk() call omits the current planning environment and random source, so teleport.js rloc() uses live RNG during preflight. The delegated RNG trace records rnd(79)=44 from randomPlace at minion.js:302 where C advances to tactics() and records rn2(5)=4. Preserve the planning context when calling rloc(); the same demon_talk() implementation also owns the separately assigned partial-payment charisma mismatch.

source.branch: The hero is polymorphed into a demon, the peaceful MS_BRIBE monster is in range and addresses the hero directly, and teleport.c tele_restrict() permits relocation. demon_talk() says the sibling greeting and calls rloc(mtmp, RLOC_MSG), discarding its return while performing relocation.
callers: monmove.c:823 dochug() calls demon_talk() for adjacent peaceful untamed MS_BRIBE monsters and consumes its return to end the monster turn.
sounds.c:1143 domonnoise() calls demon_talk() for peaceful untamed MS_BRIBE monsters and discards its return.
dependencies: teleport.c:tele_restrict() determines whether relocation is allowed.
teleport.c:rloc() performs the side-effecting relocation; demon_talk() discards its Boolean return.
monmove.c:dochug() is the admitted v79 runtime entry point.
wizard.c:tactics() is the C caller associated with the next RNG entry after the greeting branch.
